name: audio_voice_clone
description: Clones a voice (ElevenLabs) from audio or video creations into the user's My Voices. Only clone a voice the user has the right to use. Use clean speech of one speaker; up to 3 min is used. Charges credits.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language of the speech, e.g. fr.

name.description: Voice name shown in My Voices. Max 100 chars.

removeBackgroundNoise.description: Default false. Use only for noisy sources; it can thin a clean voice.

sources.description: 1-5 audio or video creation identifiers, e.g. from video_extract_audio or audio_isolate.
